children: Advancing smart pet care from "functional connectivity" to "emotional understanding"
DONGGUAN, China, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Dogness (International) Corporation ("Dogness" or the "Company") (

), a developer and manufacturer of a comprehensive line of Dogness-branded, OEM and private label pet products, today announced the Company has entered into multiple technical cooperation agreements with Google Cloud and officially launched its new-generation AI Pet Feeder.

Built with Google Gemini, the product's AI analytical model and algorithm system achieves a functional leap from "passive recording" to "active recognition," propelling smart pet products from "functional connectivity" to "emotional understanding".

Traditional smart pet feeders typically remain at the basic level of remote viewing and scheduled feeding; users can observe the video feed but may not fully interpret the pet's condition. The Dogness AI Pet Feeder is equipped with high-definition night vision and a 120-degree ultra-wide-angle camera, allowing users to seamlessly monitor their pets' eating, activities, and resting status at any time via the mobile application.

Leveraging the behavioral recognition capabilities of Google Gemini AI, the AI feeder can automatically monitor the pet's status, identify abnormal behaviors, and issue timely alerts. This proactive feature helps owners anticipate potential health risks, successfully upgrading the pet-care experience from merely "seeing" to "understanding".

"Building our cloud storage and cloud servers on Google Cloud and Google Cloud Compute Engine represents more than a simple integration of hardware and algorithms," Silong Chen, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Dogness, commented. "It signifies a profound exploration of 'AI + Pet' applications."

The introduction of the AI Pet Feeder marks a pivotal milestone in executing the Company's "Pet Smart AI Ecosystem" strategy. Looking ahead, the Company will continuously deepen its technical synergy with Google Cloud and expand application scenarios across smart feeding, health monitoring, and behavioral understanding, thereby empowering AI to genuinely facilitate and enhance the emotional connection between humans and pets.

Dogness (International) Corporation was founded in 2003 from the belief that dogs and cats are important, well-loved family members. Through its smart products, hygiene products, health and wellness products, and leash products, Dogness' technology simplifies pet lifestyles and enhances the relationship between pets and pet caregivers. The Company ensures industry-leading quality through its fully integrated vertical supply chain and world-class research and development capabilities, which have resulted in over 200 patents and patents pending. Dogness products reach families worldwide through global chain stores and distributors. For more information, please visit: ir.dogness.com.
